---

ARCHITECTURE:
production-studio/          ← root: shared skills + studio CLAUDE.md
  skills/                   ← /teach, /avatar, /voice, /animate, /cut, /ship
  scripts/                  ← API scripts
  projects/
    negotiation-trainer/    ← open session HERE
      .studio/
        brand.yaml          ← project-specific brand, voice, audience
        avatars/            ← generated character images
        assets/             ← voiceovers, demo clips
        exports/            ← rendered videos
    personal-youtube/
      .studio/brand.yaml

HOW IT WORKS:
- Claude Code walks up the directory tree and reads CLAUDE.md at each level
- Skills are defined in production-studio/skills/ (shared)
- Brand identity comes from the project's .studio/brand.yaml
- You open a session in projects/[project-name]/ — you never work across projects in same session
- Skills reference the closest brand.yaml automatically

FIRST PROJECT: negotiation-trainer (need to create .studio/ folder and brand.yaml)
